Revised to introduce a progression of guilt (as described in the game tutorial) tied to reasoned or instinctive internalization of slavery (credit to utterlyjunky for suggesting a progression and developing the formula) ! Instead of being essentially random with hard-coded fixed upper limits for each interaction, the highest level of guilt that can be felt by a slave is now capped by a max_guilt internal variable. Interactions can set upper bounds on the maximum amount of guilt they could possibly give to a slave (although many will not). For example, a comparatively "minor" violation like cumming with no-orgasm rule could be limited to 3 guilt even for a perfectly devoted slave. Meanwhile, a new slave with an uninitialized max_guilt would feel the minimum guilt (1) even for a "severe" infraction. I considered even letting disobedient slaves feel no guilt at all, but many texts in the game are written assuming that guilt is awarded (almost all of the interaction refusal texts, for example), so I kept the minimum at 1 for now. ! I also changed the behavior of gaining guilt on top of existing guilt. Now it replaces previous guilt only if the potential guilt of the new infraction is greater.
